title: bus.gamedev.progress.v1
description: One progress beat from a game-development project (first producer: unreal-battlebots-gamedev, via tools/hearth_progress.py). Deliberately ONE schema with a `kind` discriminator rather than a family of per-event schemas: hearth persists any event carrying `project` through the generic nbus_events tap, so a single well-known channel gives the phone a live timeline with zero consumer code. `screenshot_path` is what makes a visually-oriented gate reachable from the phone — hearth serves the bytes from the repo, the event only names the path.

project.description: Project slug — MUST match the repo directory name (e.g. unreal-battlebots-gamedev). Hearth's derive_event_project keys the whole nbus_events rollup on this.

kind.description: gate = automated pass/fail check (check.sh); bench = a perf measurement; shot = a visual artifact worth a human eyeball; phase = roadmap phase transition; review = a five-lens/adversarial review verdict; wave = a work wave landed

title.description: Short human line, e.g. 'check.sh 28/28' or 'Wave 3G landed'

status.description: pass/fail for gates and benches; pending when a human verdict is required (a visual gate awaiting eyes); info for narration

phase.description: Roadmap phase id this beat belongs to, e.g. '1' or '2A'

summary.description: One or two sentences of detail. Failing test names belong here.

metrics.description: Free-form numeric facts (frame_p95_ms, tests_passed, ...). Numbers only — string facts go in summary.

artifact_path.description: Absolute path to the run's artifact directory or JSON, for tap-through

screenshot_path.description: Absolute path to a PNG/JPG/WebP the phone should render. Must live inside the project checkout — hearth re-validates containment before serving bytes.

git_sha.description: Commit the beat was measured at

needs_eyes.description: True when a human must LOOK at this before the phase can proceed (a visual gate). Producers pair this with a bus.notify.v1 phone push; consumers may surface it more loudly.
